messages:
ci-bot: ALERT: trivy-scan job failed on repo `web-client` (build 4521). Embedded dependency signature mismatch for package `left-pad@1.3.0` during SBOM verification. Trivy exit code 2. Output snippet below:
```
E: signature verification failed for /tmp/sbom/left-pad-1.3.0.tgz
expected: sha256:abcd... got: sha256:1234...
Note: GHAS result: scanned, flagged SNYK-JS-2026-XXXX with severity medium
```
ci-bot: Tagging @alex_nguyen for triage and @security_team for suppression decision.

alex_nguyen: saw this. reproducible locally with `make deps-sbom-check`.
I'd rather not blanket-suppress; looks like vendor-provided tarball got re-signed upstream?
Can we confirm whether KMS key rotation caused artifact rewrite during CI?

ken_sato: @alex_nguyen I checked KMS logs — decrypts for the artifact store around the time are fine. No rotation events in last 30d. KMS request ids: `req-0a1b2c` (200 OK).

maria_gonzalez: quick triage: impact=transitive devDep, reachable=false from production bundle. Severity medium but exploitability low. Suggest create GHAS/Snyk suppression with scope `repo:web-client` and expiration 7 days while we follow up upstream.

samir_patel: +1 on scoped temp suppression, but add audit log link and JIRA ticket. Previous suppressions without audit cause problems later. We should create a short-lived exception in our suppression table and a follow-up owner.

alex_nguyen: agreed. process: 1) create vuln ticket (SEC-4132) with reproduction and SBOM artifact 2) add suppression record in `scanner.suppressions` vault with fields: repo, pkg, reason, expires_at, created_by 3) enable additional detection rule to alert if signature mismatches for same package recur

maria_gonzalez: also check GHAS auto-triage mapping — sometimes GHAS maps a trivy fingerprint to an existing Snyk entry and the suppression metadata doesn't propagate. If we suppress in Snyk but not GHAS, alerts still bubble.

ken_sato: note on implementation: our suppression schema requires a `justification_url` and `kms_encrypted_owner` blob. When you add the suppression, encrypt the owner id with `projects/scanner/kms-key-v2`. CI will decrypt at runtime to populate audit fields.

alex_nguyen: creating SEC-4132 now and attaching sbom tar. Will add suppression entry after ticket created. I'll paste the CLA for the suppression in the ticket.

ci-bot: Created comment on PR #2345: "SBOM mismatch observed, creating temp suppression SEC-4132" :info:

samir_patel: follow-up: schedule a canary re-scan across our other repos to detect similar re-signed artifacts. run: `scripts/scan-shared-deps --target left-pad --since 2026-03-01`

maria_gonzalez: policy note: for transitive non-reachable devDeps we permit 7d suppressions. For runtime deps or reachable transitive deps require patching or vendor fix within 48h or to escalate to oncall.

alex_nguyen: FYI I found upstream commit that changed publishing pipeline — looks like they replaced their sig tool. Reached out upstream maintainer (email) and opened a PR with a pinned tarball in our vendor mirror.

ken_sato: after suppression entry is created, I'll run a one-off job to ensure GHAS mapping gets the suppression: `platform/tools/ghas_sync --repo web-client --sync-suppressions`

security_bot: AUDIT EVENT: suppression.create repo=web-client package=left-pad@1.3.0 creator=alex_nguyen expires=2026-03-29 justification=SBOM mismatch pending upstream verification event_id=evt-77a9

maria_gonzalez: good. Alex — please include the KMS encrypt command in the ticket: `gcloud kms encrypt --key=projects/scanner/locations/global/keyRings/infra/cryptoKeys/scanner-key --plaintext="alex_nguyen" --ciphertext-file=owner.enc` so CI can decrypt.

alex_nguyen: done. SEC-4132 updated with owner.enc and suppression record created in `scanner.suppressions`.

samir_patel: final reminder: add a short retrospective in the ticket if this repeats — if we get >3 signature mismatches from the same upstream in 30d escalate to vendor policy review.

ci-bot: RESCAN_COMPLETE: follow-up scan across org found 1 other repo (docs-site) with same signature mismatch; ticket linked SEC-4133.

maria_gonzalez: closing loop: suppression will auto-expire; remediation owner is alex_nguyen; next steps: upstream PR, vendor pin in mirror, and run regression test in 72h. :white_check_mark:

alex_nguyen: thanks team. I'll post update in #supply-chain and link SEC tickets.

security_bot: REMINDER: suppression entries are logged to central audit index and forwarded to compliance. If this becomes repeated noise we will recommend stricter enforcement (no temporary suppressions for published packages).
file_creation_notes: Generated Slack thread capturing a vulnerability scan failure, triage decisions, suppression process, KMS encryption requirement, GHAS/Snyk mapping notes, and follow-up actions.
